professionalSummary.text: Deployed sixty-one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.
professionalSummary.witness: Deployed sixty-one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.

professionalSummary.text: Held a place on the settlement on-call rota for the whole period and handled the production incidents that fell on my shifts, including the matching backlog of March 2024 that was cleared eleven minutes before the depository cut-off; the incident records are in the settlement incident log.
professionalSummary.witness: Held a place on the settlement on-call rota for the whole period and handled the production incidents that fell on my shifts, including the matching backlog of March 2024 that was cleared eleven minutes before the depository cut-off; the incident records are in the settlement incident log.

professionalSummary.text: Watched the live settlement queue on cut-off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut-off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk.
professionalSummary.witness: Watched the live settlement queue on cut-off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut-off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk.

professionalSummary.text: Developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment, with the test window results attached to the change ticket.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment, with the test window results attached to the change ticket.

professionalSummary.text: Documented the service's known limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook.
professionalSummary.witness: Documented the service's known limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook.
